audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup was absent from every field: Lilting Lullaby only affects enemies who already have Dream Dust on them.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep.' Dream Dust comes from her abilities landing. Against a Heimerdinger who never lets Blooming Blows, Watch Out! Eep! or Swirlseed touch him, her 150s ultimate has no target at all — which turns 'her one window' into 'a window you can simply refuse'. The page instead sold it as an undodgeable ranged sleep with no counterplay beyond standing back.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[2], mid, wants.foe[2], report[5], tldr, winCon and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fields told the reader to use the grenade to 'interrupt her R channel' / 'cancel her R Lilting Lullaby channel', and mid said the beams shred her 'before her passive heals her through it'.
audit.why: Lilting Lullaby is not a channel — there is nothing in Riot's text or the kit flags describing one, so there is no cast to interrupt. And Dream-Laden Bough is a max-Health damage-over-time she applies to YOU; it heals her nothing. Both were invented mechanics the reader would plan around.
audit.corrected: Channel-cancel removed from mid and wants.you[1]; the 'passive heals her' clause replaced with the burn ticking on you.
sources: enemyKit Riot text (no channel flag, passive is damage over time)

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere despite the whole page being built on 'track Blooming Blows'.
audit.why: Blooming Blows is 6s at rank 1 down to 4s, Watch Out! Eep! 14s, Swirlseed 12s, Lilting Lullaby 150/130/110s. A 6s spin is not a cooldown you wait out — the real punishable window is the 14s W she has to walk in to land, and the 150s ultimate.
audit.corrected: 6s, 14s, 12s and 150s written into breakdown.cooldowns, mid, spikes[2], dosFull[0].d, the trading block and wants.you[1].

edits.before: This is your stretch. Eep! sweetspot, and the instant she does, center the grenade for the hard stun and the beams plus your W rockets shred her squishy frame before her passive heals her through it. notes: Biggest gap in this matchup: Lilting Lullaby only affects enemies who already carry Dream Dust from one of her abilities. The page presented it as an unavoidable ranged sleep; in fact a Heimerdinger who never eats a Q, W or E is immune to her 150s ultimate outright. Two invented mechanics removed: Lilting Lullaby has no channel to interrupt (two fields told the reader to cancel it), and Dream-Laden Bough is a max-Health burn applied to YOU, not a heal for her (mid said her passive heals her through your burst). packet.suspectNames 'Laden Bough' is a false positive.
